title: CardCorpus vocabulary
description: The words public/v1 uses, each with a label and, where curated, a tell: how to spot it. Roles, reprint differences, a variant's axes and distribution kinds; rarity words and how showy they are; catalogs and languages; set types, how they group, and links between sets; card types and pieces. A value is never renamed: a rename adds a new value (docs/static-api.md, "Vocabulary").

tell.description: How to spot it on the card, in a sentence; one with no `sources` is a draft.
